name: Wayfarer-class APC
role: Wheeled 8x8 amphibious armoured personnel carrier: moves a full Vigil section fast along colony roads, river crossings and causeways, drops them behind cover and pulls back to overwatch.
capacity: 10 Vigilants in full exosuit (two inward-facing benches of five)

weapons.main: Tally remote weapon station: heavy repeater + 40 mm grenade launcher
low-profile two-seat turret, 25 mm Wren autocannon (troops reduced to 8)
twin-tube 120 mm breech-loaded mortar module in the troop bay (roof doors)

blockout_note: Overlapping primitive shells at 1:56 mm (visual blockout, not a unioned print mesh).
